title: EY首席：美联储今年将按兵不动
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I think the dissent, but I think the Fed does not move. I think the Fed is going to be on hold through the rest of the year.
segments.zh: 我认为会有异议，但美联储不会行动。今年剩余时间美联储将按兵不动。

segments.en: The reason being that if you look at the inflation developments even though patience is running thin amongst all on the committee, you are in this environment where you have some disinflationary currents that
segments.zh: 原因是，尽管委员会内部耐心渐失，但通胀形势仍存在一些通缩力量，这些力量可能持续到年底。

segments.en: are likely to carry the way through the end of the year. Terror pressures are past their peak.
You're seeing still the effect that passed through of lower energy prices, even though we've seen this re-acceleration in oil prices and gasoline prices,
segments.zh: 尽管油价和汽油价格重新加速，但能源价格下降的传导效应仍在，仍有通缩影响。

segments.en: but there's still a disinflationary effect there. And then very importantly, the labor market is not inflationary.
segments.zh: 而且非常重要的是，劳动力市场不具有通胀性。

segments.en: Wage growth is still trending down towards 3.5%.
segments.zh: 薪资增长仍呈下降趋势，接近3.5%。

segments.en: That's not inflationary. That should not be a source of inflation going forward.
segments.zh: 这并非通胀性，不应成为未来通胀的来源。

segments.en: There are risks, however. And I think that's very important to keep in mind.
segments.zh: 然而，风险依然存在，这一点非常重要。

segments.en: September very much a live meeting. And the next meetings after that, October and November and December, will also be live meetings.
segments.zh: 9月会议非常关键，之后的10月、11月和12月会议也同样关键。

segments.en: But I think the Fed will eventually end up on the side of not tightening monetary policy.
segments.zh: 但我认为美联储最终不会收紧货币政策。

segments.en: Do you think if we get those dissents that they compromise the leadership of the new Fed share?
segments.zh: 如果出现异议票，是否会削弱新美联储主席的领导力？

segments.en: Or do they actually do them a little bit of a favor through the summer? I think that's very important to keep in mind.
segments.zh: 还是说，这反而在夏季帮了他们一把？这一点很重要。

segments.en: Because during his testimony, two days of testimony, he said a lot, but very little in terms of his views on inflation, his views on monetary policy.
segments.zh: 因为在两天的听证会上，他说了很多，但关于通胀和货币政策的观点却很少。

segments.en: He was cryptic at best. He did not say whether inflation was this number or that number, which for a Fed share, you would expect at least to express one view of a number,
segments.zh: 他非常含糊，没有明确通胀的具体数字，而作为美联储主席，至少应该表达一个数字观点。

segments.en: a gauge of inflation. He did not express any views as to whether he thought there was disinflation in the pipeline.
segments.zh: 他也没有表达是否认为通胀正在放缓。
